WITH per_media_type AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
    AND Bytes IS NOT NULL
    AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_of_media_type_averages,
  AVG(track_count) AS average_of_media_type_track_counts
FROM per_media_type;

assumptions.assumption: A zero Milliseconds value is excluded from the bytes-per-millisecond average because the ratio is undefined; its track still contributes to the media type count.
